name: 李家瑜
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.
課程進度(1-16週):
W1 Class Introduction + Three Ps of Presentation
W2 Three Ps of Presentation
W3 Types of Presentation
W4 National Holiday (9/28 教師節)
W5 Types of Presentation
W6 Easy Test Practice I + Mini presentation
W7 Easy Test Practice II + Mini presentation
W8 National Holiday (10/26 光復節補假) 
W9 Campus-Wide Exam + Presentation Proposal
W10 Campus Holiday (11/9 校慶補假)
W11 Presentation Content (I): Strong Opening
W12 Presentation Content (II): Body Structure
W13 Presentation Content (II): Body Structure
W14 Presentation Content (III): Powerful Closing
W15 Review + Group Presentation
W16 Review + Group Presentation

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
